title: isPending: show a Transition is running

slides.say: During a Transition, the old screen stays visible. Give the user a hint that something is happening.
Use the is pending flag. Here the tab button switches to a pending style right away, while the slow tab renders in the background.

slides.text: isPending becomes true at the first startTransition, and stays true until the final state is shown.
slides.say: Is pending turns true at the first start transition call, and stays true until all Actions finish and the final state is on screen.
